guide.summary: Council prioritized reclaiming RAM working sets before chasing secondary noise.
guide.chiefVerdict: Trim heavy background apps first, then rescan to confirm memory pressure eased.

councilDiscussion.content: Committed memory is elevated while disk and update services look healthy.
councilDiscussion.headline: RAM first

steps.title: Close heavy apps
steps.instructions: Close the largest non-essential apps in Task Manager and keep only what you need for the next hour of work.

steps.title: Free working sets
steps.instructions: Run the PatchGuard Optimize step that frees RAM working sets, then re-open only required apps.
